description: Cancels a creation in progress when the user asks. Irreversible. Ania asks the user (confirmation form); without one, the tool returns the question: ask it and call again with user_confirmed: true only after an explicit yes. Never decide for the user.

jobId.description: The job id from criar_avatar or ver_andamento.

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.

user_confirmed.description: Only without a confirmation prompt: true only after the user explicitly said yes.

name: cancel_avatar
title: Cancel a creation
